items.title: Goldman: is Japan's pension giant bringing money home?
items.summary: Goldman's latest look at Japan's Government Pension Investment Fund weighs whether the GPIF trims foreign assets and repatriates to yen, the question every USD/JPY trader is watching.

items.title: Bloomberg: hedge funds shift to index shorts
items.summary: Hedge funds are moving from single-stock shorts to shorting the Nasdaq via QQQ, which can lift correlations and threaten the low-VIX regime after October’s ~8% tech drawdown.

items.title: Asia open: Korea chips hit by US AI selloff
items.summary: Alphabet, Intel and Amazon weakness carried into Asia; KOSPI opened lower with SK Hynix and Samsung sold on hyperscaler capex-payback doubts rather than an HBM demand drop.

items.title: DAR joins the $$$ Shopping List
items.summary: Large call spread on 10/28: 10,000 April $62.50 calls bought against 13,000 $72.50 calls sold; ~$55 spot near key support after a ~20% pullback from summer highs. Desk likes the setup for a recovery.

items.title: Goldman: Alphabet’s $350B capex bill
items.summary: Goldman’s Q3 review: Cloud revenue up ~103% with a huge backlog while Search slows; capex seen near $203B in 2026 and $350B in 2027, so free cash flow gets squeezed.

items.title: LYV ($$): Dec $155 puts sold into earnings
items.summary: 1,350 Dec $155 puts sold to open at $2.12 on 10/22 ahead of the 11/5 report, followed by Sept 2027 $180 call buying; ~$178 spot coiled under the August highs. Desk views the put sales as the bullish way in.

items.title: NXPI ($$): March 2027 $300 calls bought
items.summary: Buyer of 250 March 2027 $300 calls at $17.10 on 10/29 as the stock (~$266) bounced off the 200-day and set a 60-day high; Jan $290/$320 call ratio spreads still in open interest. Desk sees the 200-day near $247 as support.

items.title: Alphabet slides, but breadth finds another door
items.summary: Nasdaq looked far worse than the tape underneath: 400+ S&P names rose as money rotated to small caps, value and rate-sensitive cyclicals while investors questioned AI capex payback.

items.title: Desk market wrap 10/29
items.summary: Tech soft on Alphabet spend worries; breadth improved and vol compressed. Equal-weight indexes hit multi-week highs. Autos, retail, building materials, payments rotated higher. Watching Amazon into the week close.
